name: Commodity Momentum + Correlation Filter
description: Commodity momentum strategy (Fuertes/Miffre/Rallis framework) with correlation filter. Ranks commodities by trailing return over 6-month lookback. Selects top-k momentum candidates, then from those, picks top-n assets with lowest average pairwise correlation to the broader universe. Favors decorrelated momentum winners for portfolio diversification. Equal-weights held assets. Falls back to equal-weight if all have negative momentum.
